entries.label: Enable stamina system
entries.help: Toggle the generic player-resource stamina rules on or off for this mod.

entries.label: Drain multiplier
entries.help: Scales all stamina drain rules: roll, shield, climb, hang, swim, and sprint.

entries.label: Regen multiplier
entries.help: Scales how quickly stamina refills after the regen delay.

entries.label: Show contextual ring
entries.help: Draw the BOTW-style stamina ring near Link when stamina is being used or recovering.

entries.label: Show mana-style bar
entries.help: Draw a yellow stamina bar below the magic meter using the same HUD style.

entries.label: HUD scale
entries.help: Applies to the contextual stamina ring and the mana-style stamina bar.

entries.label: HUD opacity
entries.help: Controls the shared alpha used by the contextual ring and the mana-style stamina bar.
